import pytest
from solution import find_max


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: find_max([(2, 4), (6, 7), (5, 1), (6, 10), (8, 7)]) == 10."""
    # max(2,4,6,7,5,1,6,10,8,7) = 10
    assert find_max([(2, 4), (6, 7), (5, 1), (6, 10), (8, 7)]) == 10


def test_issue_max_first_position():
    """Maximum element can be the first item of a tuple, not only the second."""
    # max(9,1,2,3) = 9
    assert find_max([(9, 1), (2, 3)]) == 9


def test_issue_single_tuple():
    """Find the maximum element of a single tuple record."""
    # max(3,7) = 7
    assert find_max([(3, 7)]) == 7


def test_issue_negative_values():
    """Find the maximum element when all elements are negative."""
    # max(-5,-2,-10,-1) = -1
    assert find_max([(-5, -2), (-10, -1)]) == -1


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Find the maximum element when all elements are equal."""
    # max(4,4,4,4) = 4
    assert find_max([(4, 4), (4, 4)]) == 4


def test_issue_zero_between_negatives():
    """Find the maximum element with mixed negatives and zero."""
    # max(-3,0,-2,-1) = 0
    assert find_max([(-3, 0), (-2, -1)]) == 0


def test_issue_duplicate_max():
    """Find the maximum element when the maximum appears in two records."""
    # max(5,1,1,5) = 5
    assert find_max([(5, 1), (1, 5)]) == 5


def test_issue_many_tuples():
    """Find the maximum element across many tuple records."""
    # max(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,0) = 7
    assert find_max([(1, 2), (3, 4), (5, 6), (7, 0)]) == 7


def test_contract_scalar_type():
    """Maximum element must be an element, not a tuple record."""
    # max(2,4,6,7) = 7, so type is int
    assert isinstance(find_max([(2, 4), (6, 7)]), int)


def test_contract_input_not_mutated():
    """Finding the maximum must not mutate the given list of records."""
    data = [(1, 2), (3, 4)]
    find_max(data)
    assert data == [(1, 2), (3, 4)]


def test_issue_empty_raises():
    """Empty input has no maximum element so must raise instead of returning."""
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        find_max([])
